detailed_description: 2D-animated. A modern flat-colour anime illustration with bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, bright flat cel colours and one simple step of soft lavender shading. [Shot 1] The shot's keyframe corresponds to <Picture 1>, whose framing, set and light hold from the first frame to the last. Night: the window at the left edge is a dark navy blur, warm lamplight from the left. Close on the girl, her head and shoulders filling the frame, lit from below by the cool white glow of a laptop screen just below the frame. Her eyes stay lowered toward the bottom edge; her shoulders dip and bob gently as her hands, below the frame, type in small bursts. The girl (S1), an early-teens girl with a bright, light, crisp voice, reads it out as she types, a little shy but serious, <d>[English] I want to make this... into a real film.</d> Her lips close and the speaking motion stops, and her shy, determined little smile deepens, her cheeks turning faintly pink. The camera holds a static shot. Through every frame the picture keeps the look of <Picture 1>: the same bold, clean dark outlines of even weight, the same bright flat cel colours with one simple step of soft shading, the same palette and light, drawn as hand-animated 2D anime with crisp, steady line work. The girl keeps her look exactly as in <Picture 1> in every frame: a wavy black bob with violet-dyed tips underneath and one small curl sticking up on top, a white headband printed with violet stars tied in a big bow on top of her head, a black choker, an oversized white hoodie with a violet konte logo on the chest and a thin violet shoulder-bag strap across it, her face, big dark eyes and hair shape unchanged.

overall_soundscape: Soft rain on the dark window at night, with a faint, quiet bedroom room tone underneath. The light patter of laptop keys in small bursts.
